item.title: DIY
item.description:
Disorient DIY is a communal effort. We provide the location, and materials. You can also bring art supplies to use with others!

We only require: you, and your creativity.

 

This year we will have:

 

Heat press with dye sublimation designs (back by popular demand!)

 

Perler Beads

 

Solar Print

 

Draw Your Own Portrait

 

(looking for help with) Airbrush body painting!
